verdict.rationale: Silencing notifications with a Do Not Disturb mode is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions notifications, Focus, or a Do Not Disturb setting. The cited items cover Snap layouts, Windows Hello, Game Bar, developer SDKs and community complaints unrelated to notification silencing.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can silence notifications using a Do Not Disturb mode
